frequency_question: How often do official policy reversals of bilateral trade/financial bans satisfy strict formal announcement and comprehensive (non-partial) criteria within 365 days?
membership_rule: Includes state-level formal trade, commercial, or financial bans implemented between sovereign nations; excludes multilateral UN sanctions, private boycotts, and informal/unannounced easing.

cases.name: Turkey-UAE normalization and economic trade thaw (2021)
Kenya-Somalia qat ban lifting and reinstatement disputes (2021)

coverage_note: 8 named historical bilateral economic ban reversals; 7 fully met formal official announcement and comprehensive criteria within one year.
known_gaps: Potential selection bias toward prominent geopolitical reconciliations; smaller bilateral trade disputes rarely tracked systematically.
validity_reason: Bilateral trade dispute resolution dynamics and diplomatic norms remain stable over medium-term horizons.
